title: Lost Signal
intro: Late at night, Toddy's phone suddenly shows "No service".
Then a few messages arrive on the laptop.
This isn't a message to judge. It's an attack in progress. What do you do?

p.text: Mobile provider: "Your number has been moved to a new SIM card."
Ostrel: "Password reset requested. Code sent by SMS."
Email provider: "Someone is trying to sign in to your account."

foot.text: All from the companies' real addresses

nosignal.label: Sudden "No service"
nosignal.lens: Your phone lost its signal for no reason.
nosignal.why: In a SIM swap, your number moves to the thief's SIM.

sim.label: SIM moved
sim.lens: Your number moved to a new SIM you didn't ask for.
sim.why: That's a SIM swap: the thief now gets your text codes.

reset.label: Password reset by SMS
reset.lens: Someone is resetting your exchange password.
reset.why: With your number, they receive the codes.

reset2.label: Email sign-in attempts
reset2.lens: Someone is going after your email.

subject.label: Several emails
subject.why: The real alerts are helping you here.

foot.label: Real senders
foot.why: These alerts are genuine; the attack is real.

actions.label: Go to sleep and deal with it tomorrow
Call your mobile provider now from another phone, then lock your accounts

verify.line: The provider froze the number, and Toddy locked the exchange and email in time.

go_ahead.line: By morning, the thief had used the text codes to empty the exchange account.

block_report.line: These were real warnings. Marking them as spam gave the thief the night.

what_if.go_ahead: Losing signal plus reset emails means act now: call the provider from another phone.
what_if.block_report: These alerts were real. A SIM swap needs action, not deletion.

golden_rule: Sudden "No service" plus reset emails means a SIM swap. Call your provider at once, and use an app for codes instead of SMS.

quick_check.q: Your phone loses signal and you get password-reset emails. What's happening?

options.text: Probably a SIM swap; act now

quick_check.explain: Thieves move your number to their SIM to receive your codes.

hints.nudge: What links the lost signal and the reset emails?

rows.v: Moved to a new SIM you did not ask for
